chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadala ibn Ayub, from Jameel, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), regarding the Ablution,
he said: 'When the water touches your skin, so it is sufficient for you.'

key_terms.فَحَسْبُكَ: So it is sufficient for you

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum requirement for water to suffice for wudu according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam Abu Ja'far (al-Baqir) establishes that the mere contact of water with the skin is sufficient for the validity of wudu, countering later juristic debates regarding the necessity of repeated washing or specific durations. This narration underscores the Shia principle of avoiding excess (israf) in ritual purity, aligning with the Prophetic tradition of moderation. It serves as a foundational text for the legal maxim that the obligation is fulfilled by the essential act of washing, without requiring superfluous repetition.

en.hubeali: A number of companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Jameel, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws regarding the Ablution (Wudhu),
said: ‘When the water touches your skin, so it is sufficient for you’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Jamil from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is sufficient for Wudu’ to allow water to touch your skin (of the parts to be washed for Wudu’).”’
